meta.title: Credit/Debit Note GL/Accounting Posting Integration: refused for a user without the Finance Controller role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Finance Controller role and attempt Credit/Debit Note GL/Accounting Posting Integration, recording whether posting is refused or absent.
Repeat the action as a Finance Controller and verify that approved notes can be posted automatically to the GL through the ERP integration.
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan and determine whether RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles.
